# Slides skill

> Presentation decks as static files: HTML fragments, one per slide, on a fixed 1920×1080 stage that scales to any screen and prints to a PDF with one slide per page. There is no build step. The engine is plain ES modules, Tailwind CSS v4 (the browser build), Alpine.js (templating) and highlight.js (code) load from a CDN. Slides are styled with Tailwind utilities plus a few component classes. Serve the repo root with any static server (`python3 -m http.server`). The page does not work from file://.

Read AGENT.md first for the rules. Then use the docs below as the task needs them. Every path is relative to the repo root.

## Start here

- [AGENT.md](../AGENT.md): what the skill is, the repo map, the workflow and the hard rules (1920×1080, no build, 300-line limit, visual only, print must work).
- [Getting started](getting-started.md): create a deck from the starter, serve it, present it, keyboard controls.

## Writing slides

- [Slide format](slide-format.md): the fragment file, the `data-*` attributes on `<section>` (section, title, tone, bare, full, rail), Alpine `x-data` / `x-for` / `x-text`, `$store.deck` from config.js, and reveal animations (`r d1…d6`).
- [Layout](layout.md): Tailwind on a fixed stage (no responsive variants), the frame, vertical rhythm (`my-auto`, `mt-auto`), grid and flex recipes, spacing and widths.
- [Components](components.md): the surface-aware colours (`text-fg-muted`, `bg-surface`, `border-edge`), the type scale (`text-h2` …), cards, lists, numbered rows, stats, pills, flows, quotes, tables and cover furniture.
- [Patterns](patterns.md): which showcase slide to copy for each need (cover, agenda, problem, boundary, numbers, code, process, compare, quote, divider, FAQ, close).
- [Code and media](code-and-media.md): code panels with highlight.js, full-bleed video slides, images and logos.

## Look and output

- [Theming](theming.md): the `@theme` tokens (`--color-*`, `--text-*`), the paper and deep surfaces, and how to rebrand a single deck.
- [Print and PDF](print.md): print preview (P or `?print`), Save as PDF settings, the fit check (`Deck.checkFit()` or `?fit`), and verifying with headless Chrome.

## Engine

- [Engine internals](engine.md): what each engine module does, the load order, the `window.Deck` console API, CDN versions, and how to vendor the libraries for offline use.

## Examples

- [decks/starter/](../decks/starter/index.html): a three-slide template to copy for a new deck.
- [decks/showcase/](../decks/showcase/index.html): one slide per layout pattern.
- [decks/showcase/slides/06-code.html](../decks/showcase/slides/06-code.html): code panels, a callout and a flow strip.
- [decks/showcase/slides/01-cover.html](../decks/showcase/slides/01-cover.html): cover with a logo lockup, `x-if` and the `$store` byline.
